newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: Philips surges and takes centre stage.
newsitem.headline: Philips surges and takes centre stage.

text.p: Shares in Philips Electronics NV surged on Wednesday in active trading, boosted by both fundamental and technical factors.
The stock gained 2.30 guilders, or 3.3 percent, to 71.70 guilders, just below an earlier peak of 71.90 guilders.
Dealers say the stock rose not only on news of the loosening of Philips' ties with ailing German Grundig, but also on the surge of peer Nokia and a good performing semiconductor sector.

"There's also an essential technical point. After hovering below 70 guilders for quite some time, the shares have finally crossed the 70.50 guilders barrier. They now look set for a further rise to the next barrier," one dealer said.
Dealers foresee a rise towards 74-75 guilders.
